# Watch · 值更 (AgentRelay) — Full Context for AI Search & LLMs

> Canonical Site: https://relay.bobochang.cn/ (zh-CN) | https://relay.bobochang.cn/en/ (en)
> Author: can4hou6joeng4 (https://bobochang.cn)
> Generated: 2026-10-14. License: MIT

---

## 1. Core System & Overview

Watch (Chinese: 值更, also called AgentRelay) is a free, local-only CLI and macOS desktop tool that hands an in-progress AI coding-agent session (conversation history, tool call events, and exact working directory) between Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, OpenCode, Kimi CLI, Pi and Grok CLI when an agent hits account usage limits or gets stuck.

### Key Safety Constraints
- 100% Local Execution: Watch has no cloud relay, server, or analytics. It reads and writes local disk stores directly.
- Strict CWD Matching: Prevents code edits across different workspaces or Git worktrees.
- Target Writer Guard: Direct writes to Codex inspect native per-thread writer locks (~/.codex/thread-writer-locks/<id>.lock via lsof) and pre/post content fingerprints.
- OpenCode SQLite Isolation: Multi-table writes (sessions, messages, parts) execute in one SQLite transaction and roll back on failure; supports WATCH_OPENCODE_DB isolation.
- Tool Call Degradation: Complex proprietary tool call events are downgraded to structured text representations in target agents.

---

## 2. Intent-to-Route Decision Matrix

| User Intent / Failure Scenario | Source Agent | Target Agent | Handoff Route | Primary Command | Data Preservation & Safety |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 5-hour / weekly usage limit reached | Claude Code | OpenAI Codex | Official Desktop Import | `npm run watch -- import-codex prepare <id> --desktop-project` | Target writer lock probe; tool calls degrade to text; CWD strictly verified |
| Context window full (200k tokens) | Claude Code | Claude Code | Native `/compact` | `/compact` (in Claude) | Handled natively inside Claude Code; no tool switch required |
| Switch to local offline model | Claude Code | OpenCode | SQLite Store Adapter | `npm run watch -- open <id> --to opencode` | Single SQLite transaction rollback on failure; custom DB via WATCH_OPENCODE_DB |
| Opus 5.5 limit after saved reset | Claude Code | OpenAI Codex | Official Desktop Import | `npm run watch -- import-codex prepare <id>` | Official reset token consumed; preserve investigation context |
| Resume past session in original agent | Any | Same Agent | Native Resume | `claude --resume <id>` / `codex resume <id>` / `opencode -s <id>` | Native CLI history lookup; no translation required |

---

## 3. Technical Guides (Full Text & Official Procedures)

### Guide: Continuing in Codex After Claude Code Reaches Usage Limit (Claude Code 达到使用限额后转入 Codex 继续实操指南)
- URL (zh): https://relay.bobochang.cn/guides/claude-code-limit-to-codex/
- URL (en): https://relay.bobochang.cn/en/guides/claude-code-limit-to-codex/
- Direct Answer (en): When Claude Code reports a five-hour or weekly limit, /compact does not restore quota. Watch reads only the local ~/.claude/projects/<encoded-cwd>/<session>.jsonl, checks the working directory, and copies that record into Codex. The original file stays unchanged. Tool events may become text.
- 核心解答 (zh): Claude Code 提示 5 小时或周限额时，/compact 不能恢复额度。Watch 只读取本机 ~/.claude/projects/<编码目录>/<会话>.jsonl，核对工作目录后转入 Codex；原文件不改，工具事件可能降级为文本。

#### Procedure Steps:
1. **Step 1: Verify source session ID and working directory**: Locate the active Claude Code session ID. History is stored under ~/.claude/projects/<encoded-cwd>/<session-id>.jsonl. Ensure the directory path (cwd) matches the actual project workspace to prevent worktree and repository misalignments.
1. **Step 2: Ensure target project exists in Codex Desktop**: Under official external agent import requirements, the destination workspace must already be registered in Codex Desktop. Open the folder in Codex Desktop beforehand to establish local trust and project recognition.
1. **Step 3: Prepare the import plan (Prepare)**: In Watch Desktop, select the source session and click OpenAI Codex, or run the prepare CLI command. This stage performs read-only checks, verifies lock status, and establishes an execution journal without modifying target files.
1. **Step 4: Confirm import and review degradation items (Confirm)**: Review the previewed message count, working directory, and tool call traces. Explicitly confirm to initiate the transfer via the local Codex app-server import protocol. Note that tool call events may degrade into text representations.
1. **Step 5: Launch the target client independently (Open)**: Once confirmed, open Codex Desktop using the app interface or resume command. Import and opening are strictly separated: if launching fails, retry opening only without repeating the import phase.

#### Frequently Asked Questions:
- **Q: Does Watch bypass or reset Claude Code rate limits?**
  A: No. Watch is a local handoff utility. It does not tamper with Anthropic accounts or inject credits; it transfers locally saved session artifacts into another agent that has active capacity.
- **Q: Can I immediately prompt Codex to continue coding?**
  A: Codex will inspect the imported conversation history, but model performance on resumed tasks depends on the target agent's context capacity. We recommend asking Codex to summarize the current objective before assigning new code edits.
- **Q: What happens if I submit an import twice?**
  A: Watch enforces persistent locks and plan idempotency. Duplicate prepare requests for the same source and directory return the existing plan without duplicating records.

---

### Guide: OpenCode, Claude & Codex Bidirectional Session Handoff Guide (OpenCode 与 Claude/Codex 双向会话接力与 SQLite 数据隔离指南)
- URL (zh): https://relay.bobochang.cn/guides/opencode-handover-sqlite-isolation/
- URL (en): https://relay.bobochang.cn/en/guides/opencode-handover-sqlite-isolation/
- Direct Answer (en): OpenCode keeps sessions in ~/.local/share/opencode/opencode.db. WATCH_OPENCODE_DB points Watch at another file. Watch writes sessions, messages, and parts in one SQLite transaction and rolls back if it fails. Unsupported tool fields become text. Later replies depend on the model you configure.
- 核心解答 (zh): OpenCode 的会话在本机 ~/.local/share/opencode/opencode.db，可用 WATCH_OPENCODE_DB 换库。Watch 用一次 SQLite 事务写入 sessions、messages、parts；事务失败会回滚。不支持的工具参数降级为文本，续写质量取决于你配置的模型。

#### Procedure Steps:
1. **Step 1: Identify source session ID and working directory**: Locate your active session ID. Claude Code stores files in ~/.claude/projects/; Codex in ~/.codex/sessions/; OpenCode indexes sessions via globally unique IDs. Verify that the working directory is an absolute path to maintain project boundary alignment.
1. **Step 2: Preflight target database status (Check)**: Run Watch CLI with --check to probe the target OpenCode database. Watch validates write permissions and locks on ~/.local/share/opencode/opencode.db (or the custom path specified by WATCH_OPENCODE_DB) to prevent concurrent write contention.
1. **Step 3: Execute bidirectional handoff (Handoff)**: Select the source session in Watch Desktop and target OpenCode, or run the CLI open command. Watch extracts incremental turns, executes atomic SQLite transactions across sessions, messages, and parts, and issues the destination session ID.
1. **Step 4: Resume session natively in OpenCode (Resume)**: After conversion, execute opencode -s <session-id> in the workspace directory or trigger the launch button in Watch Desktop. OpenCode loads the recorded conversation in that working directory.

#### Frequently Asked Questions:
- **Q: What is the advantage of OpenCode's SQLite storage over JSONL?**
  A: SQLite provides ACID transactions and robust indexing, eliminating the risk of line truncation or file corruption during unexpected termination. The WATCH_OPENCODE_DB override also facilitates isolated test environments.
- **Q: Are custom model reasoning thoughts retained when handing off out of OpenCode?**
  A: Watch copies the saved user prompts, assistant text, thinking traces, and tool outputs it can map. Unsupported tool fields become text, so the copy is not a complete replica of the OpenCode row.
- **Q: How does Watch prevent working directory mismatch?**
  A: Watch strictly binds the source session's absolute cwd to the OpenCode session entry. When resuming via opencode -s <session-id>, OpenCode locks to that workspace, preventing accidental edits in the wrong directory.

---

### Guide: Context Window Full vs Usage Limits in Claude Code: Practical Guide (Claude Code 上下文满与账户限额的本质区别与应对实操指南)
- URL (zh): https://relay.bobochang.cn/guides/context-limit-vs-usage-limit-handoff/
- URL (en): https://relay.bobochang.cn/en/guides/context-limit-vs-usage-limit-handoff/
- Direct Answer (en): A full context window means this conversation is too long: run /compact or /clear inside Claude Code. An account limit names a reset time, and /compact does nothing then. Watch neither enlarges the window nor restores quota. It copies the saved session into another agent that can still run.
- 核心解答 (zh): 上下文满了是这一次对话太长，在 Claude Code 里执行 /compact 或 /clear。账户限额到了会给出重置时间，此时 /compact 无效。Watch 不扩大上下文，也不恢复额度，只把已保存的会话记录转入另一个仍可用的 Agent。

#### Procedure Steps:
1. **Step 1: Check terminal error signals to identify the limit type**: If Claude reports "exceeded your limit" with a reset time, it is an account Usage Limit: running /compact will fail because the model quota is exhausted; wait for reset or hand off to Codex / OpenCode. If Claude reports conversation length limits or high latency, it is a Context Window Limit: run /compact.
1. **Step 2: Apply native resolution for context length (/compact & /clear)**: Inside Claude Code, run /compact to compress conversation history into a distilled summary. If historical investigative turns are no longer required, run /clear to begin a clean slate in the current workspace.
1. **Step 3: Save session state upon hitting account usage quotas**: Verify Claude Code has flushed its session transcript to ~/.claude/projects/<enc-cwd>/<session-id>.jsonl. Use Watch to inspect the working directory and target readiness for Codex or OpenCode.
1. **Step 4: Hand off to an alternative agent without repeating context**: Use Watch to convert the recorded reasoning and test results into the destination agent's format, then resume in the new CLI with full preceding context.

#### Frequently Asked Questions:
- **Q: Will /compact discard code modifications made on disk?**
  A: No. File edits already exist on your local filesystem. /compact only compresses in-memory conversation history. However, detailed sub-error messages may be summarized.
- **Q: Why does /compact fail when hitting an account usage limit?**
  A: /compact requires calling the underlying LLM to generate the conversation summary. When your account quota is exhausted, all API requests are blocked. In this scenario, switching to another agent via Watch is the only immediate continuation path.
- **Q: Does handing off to Codex or OpenCode reset context?**
  A: The destination agent receives a fresh context window initialized with the preceding task summary and command outputs, resolving context saturation from the previous session.

---

### Guide: What Claude Opus 5.5 changes about five-hour limits, and what to do when you are still capped (Claude Opus 5.5 提高 5 小时限额之后，限额和会话接力分别怎么处理)
- URL (zh): https://relay.bobochang.cn/guides/opus-5-5-five-hour-limit/
- URL (en): https://relay.bobochang.cn/en/guides/opus-5-5-five-hour-limit/
- Direct Answer (en): Opus 5.5 raises the five-hour limit on Pro, Max, Team, and seat-based Enterprise, and adds one reset you can save. It does not remove the limit. Watch does not read or raise Claude quota. Hand the saved session to Codex only after that official reset is still not enough.
- 核心解答 (zh): Opus 5.5 提高的是 Pro、Max、Team 和按席位 Enterprise 的 5 小时限额，并给一次可保存的重置，不是取消限额。Watch 不读取、不增加 Claude 额度。官方重置用完后若仍被拦住，再把本机会话转入 Codex。

#### Procedure Steps:
1. **Step 1: Read which limit the product is reporting**: A message that you have exceeded the current usage limit, with a reset time, is an account limit. /compact does not restore that quota. A message about conversation length is a context-window limit. Compact inside Claude Code. Switching the model name is not the fix for either case.
1. **Step 2: Use the plan’s own five-hour limit and saved reset**: The higher five-hour limit applies to Pro, Max, Team, and seat-based Enterprise. The savable reset belongs to the Claude subscription. Watch has not verified a CLI flag that stores it, so do not assume a Watch command has banked the reset for you. If you are still blocked after the reset Anthropic provides, then consider another agent.
1. **Step 3: Hand off only if Claude is still blocked**: Watch does not read, raise, or bypass Claude quota. It copies a session already saved on disk into Codex, keeping the working directory. Follow the existing guide, Continuing in Codex after Claude Code reaches its usage limit: check the session id and directory, then prepare, confirm, and open Codex separately.

#### Frequently Asked Questions:
- **Q: Does Claude Opus 5.5 remove the five-hour usage limit?**
  A: No. Anthropic increased the five-hour limit on Pro, Max, Team, and seat-based Enterprise. The limit still exists, and hitting it still shows a reset time.
- **Q: Can Watch spend the savable rate-limit reset for me?**
  A: No. That control belongs to the Claude subscription. Watch does not sign in to a Claude account, and it neither stores nor spends the reset.
- **Q: Do I still hand the session to Codex after the limit increase?**
  A: Only when the official reset is not enough and Codex still has quota. The handoff steps did not change with Opus 5.5.
